status: Secondary diagnostic, logged after the 5000-step clean/noise scores and before final recovery/geometry inspection. No new training or tuning.
question: Does denoising training still improve logical recovery after giving every network the analytic references' known-subspace projection and matching output bounds?
models: All 60 final checkpoints; same fixed held-out clean bits and paired noise as the primary pilot.
projection: x -> x*A*A^T on all 32 observations; A has 16 orthonormal columns. This removes observation noise in dimensions uninformative about clean labels, leaving all feature-plane perturbations unchanged.
clipping: Clip logical output predictions to [0,1], independently of their target labels.
verification: Verify every final network's canonical feature-plane predictions are invariant under projection; reconstruct all class-conditional errors from stored float32 predictions. Keep this separate from primary geometry and scores.
oracle_refinement: After inspecting the 31x31 exact-denoiser contours, repeat its four canonical task/pair cases at 61x61 and 121x121. Check the low AND exponent and XOR fit failures are not coarse-grid artifacts. No settings or model selection changes.
stopping_rule: One final-checkpoint diagnostic on the existing models and data, no extra seeds, training, task families or noise levels.
